_about: Hand-picked points on the scanned metro survey sheets (BMRCL without tunnel-1.pdf, 8 sheets along Sarjapura Road). Pixel positions are in each page's embedded scan image (3308 x 2338 px), x right, y down. Benchmarks are the crossed squares at the end of each 'BM No' leader; their eastings and northings (UTM 43N) are printed on the sheet. The sheets are NOT all at one scale: a sheet with two benchmarks gets its scale and rotation from them; a sheet with one gets its scale from track chainages printed on the sheets (see scale_basis) and is taken as north-up.

1.scale_basis: the station centre mark must lie 460.8 m of track from the 'Bridge intersection' mark placed from sheet 3 (chainages 20+256.159 and 19+795.348); agrees with the lengths '200' and '61' written on this sheet

shapes.what: St John's Hospital metro station (Phase-3A), station box

St John's Hospital metro station: parking and pick-up / drop-off area
St John's Hospital metro station: structure on the north side of Sarjapura Road (T-02), likely an entrance

3.scale_basis: the 'Bridge intersection' and 'Null point' marks are both on this sheet and 216.655 m of track apart (chainages 19+795.348 and 19+578.693); the null point then lands 2.5 m from where sheet 4's two benchmarks put it

shapes.what: Metro Phase-3A: land marked for the line's structure at junction A, in the St John's hostel grounds
Metro Phase-3A: box drawn at junction A (about 25 m by 31 m), beside the sheets' 'Bridge intersection' mark

5.scale_basis: the station box is taken to be as long as Jakkasandra's (134 m, from sheet 8's two benchmarks); the 25 m pillar spacings written on this sheet give the same scale. The station centre is 89 px from the benchmark, so its position hardly depends on the scale: it lands 510 m of track from the null point, as the chainages say
